mentions.name: Agentry
mentions.description: Agentry is a runtime, connection, and deploy layer for building internal apps and automations with AI. It lets users run their own model and harness on their own laptop or server, enabling apps of the kind built with Lovable or Replit, with example apps hosted on its domain.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Agentry(https://agentry.run/)
Runtime, connection, and deploy layer for building internal apps and automations with AI. You can build anything that you can build with Lovable, Replit etc. Your model, Your harness and your own Laptop/Server
